Name.description: The database name, **unique** across your organization.

Hostname.description: The DNS hostname used for client libSQL and HTTP connections.

block_reads.description: The current status for blocked reads.

block_writes.description: The current status for blocked writes.

regions.description: A list of regions for the group the database belongs to.

primaryRegion.description: The primary region location code the group the database belongs to.

group.description: The name of the group the database belongs to.

delete_protection.description: The current status for delete protection. If enabled, the database cannot be deleted.

name.description: The name of the parent database.

branched_at.description: The timestamp when the database was branched from the parent.
